summary: Pharvaris N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly results including share premium, stock option activity, compensation expenses, and accruals. It references prior financing transactions with Morgan Stanley and Leerink Partners and an office lease, but no new corporate event. This is a standard interim report for a foreign private issuer.
